articles.title: Trump Releases Healthcare Framework Aimed at Lowering Costs
articles.mainIdea: Trump Releases Healthcare Framework Aimed at Lowering Costs
articles.summary: The Wall Street Journal: Trump Releases Healthcare Framework Aimed at Lowering Costs. WASHINGTON—President Trump is urging Congress to make healthcare a priority this year, endorsing a series of proposals that come as his party faces mounting political pressure over rising costs ahead of the midterm elections. The White House released a healthcare framework on Thursday, called “The Great Healthcare Plan,” which seeks to lower prescription drug prices, increase price transparency and redirect federal subsidies from insurers to consumers. The plan brings together ideas that have been pitched by several lawmakers and asks Congress to codify executive actions designed to bring U.S. drug prices in line with the lowest level paid by other rich countries.
